sample_pyq_records.source: Reported by candidates from SBI Clerk Prelims Jan 2024 Shift 1
sample_pyq_records.question_en:
Statements:
Only a few Books are Pens.
All Pens are Erasers.
No Eraser is Sharpener.

Conclusions:
I. Some Books are definitely not Sharpener.
II. All Books being Pens is a possibility.
sample_pyq_records.question_hi:
कथन:
केवल कुछ Books, Pens हैं।
सभी Pens, Erasers हैं।
कोई Eraser, Sharpener नहीं है।

निष्कर्ष:
I. कुछ Books निश्चित रूप से Sharpener नहीं हैं।
II. सभी Books के Pens होने की संभावना है।
options: Either conclusion I or II follows
Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow
sample_pyq_records.solution_en:
1. 'Only a few Books are Pens' means Some Books are Pens AND Some Books are NOT Pens. Therefore, 'All Books being Pens' is IMPOSSIBLE! So Conclusion II is false.
2. The Pens that are in Books cannot be Sharpener (since Pens are inside Eraser and No Eraser is Sharpener). Hence, those Books which are Pens can never be Sharpener. Thus, 'Some Books are definitely not Sharpener' is 100% TRUE.
Therefore, Only conclusion I follows.
sample_pyq_records.solution_hi:
1. 'केवल कुछ Books, Pens हैं' का अर्थ है कि कुछ Books, Pens नहीं हैं। अतः 'सभी Books के Pens होने की संभावना' गलत है (निष्कर्ष II गलत)।
2. जो Books, Pens हैं वे कभी Sharpener नहीं हो सकते (क्योंकि कोई Eraser, Sharpener नहीं है)। अतः निष्कर्ष I निश्चित रूप से सत्य है।
सही उत्तर: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है।
sample_pyq_records.shortcut: The 'Only a few' Negation rule: 'All A being B is a possibility' is AUTOMATICALLY FALSE when 'Only a few A are B' is given.
sample_pyq_records.exam_trick: Check Conclusion II first: It says All Books being Pens is a possibility, which directly contradicts 'Only a few Books are Pens'. Rule out II in 3 seconds!
sample_pyq_records.trap: Thinking 'few' means some, without noticing 'Only a few' restricts the entirety from joining.

sample_pyq_records.source: Reported IBPS Clerk Prelims August 2023 Shift 2
sample_pyq_records.question_en:
Statements: M > K ≥ P = L < Q; P ≥ R > T
Conclusions:
I. M > R
II. L < T
sample_pyq_records.question_hi:
कथन: M > K ≥ P = L < Q; P ≥ R > T
निष्कर्ष:
I. M > R
II. L < T
options: Either conclusion I or II follows
Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow
sample_pyq_records.solution_en:
For Conclusion I (M > R):
Trace path: M > K ≥ P ≥ R. Since all gates are open towards R and we have a strict '>' between M and K, M > R definitely follows! (True)
For Conclusion II (L < T):
L = P ≥ R > T, which means L > T. The conclusion claims L < T, which is definitively false.
Therefore, Only conclusion I follows.
sample_pyq_records.solution_hi:
निष्कर्ष I (M > R) के लिए:
M > K ≥ P ≥ R, अतः M > R सत्य है।
निष्कर्ष II (L < T) के लिए:
L = P ≥ R > T, यानी L > T बनता है। अतः L < T असत्य है।
सही उत्तर: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है।
sample_pyq_records.shortcut: Door method: From M we can reach R with open gates and '>' is present. From L we see open gate towards T, meaning L > T, so L < T is false.
sample_pyq_records.exam_trick: Path M -> K -> P -> R is direct. Solvable on sight in 8 seconds.
sample_pyq_records.trap: Switching signs when comparing L and T.

sample_pyq_records.source: Reported IBPS RRB Office Assistant Prelims August 2024 Shift 1
sample_pyq_records.question_en: In a row of students facing North, Rohan is 14th from the left end and Priya is 18th from the right end. When they interchange their positions, Rohan becomes 22nd from the left end. How many students are there in the row?
sample_pyq_records.question_hi: उत्तर की ओर मुख किए छात्रों की एक पंक्ति में, रोहन बाएँ छोर से 14वें स्थान पर है और प्रिया दाएँ छोर से 18वें स्थान पर है। जब वे आपस में स्थान बदलते हैं, तो रोहन बाएँ छोर से 22वें स्थान पर आ जाता है। पंक्ति में कुल कितने छात्र हैं?
sample_pyq_records.solution_en:
After interchange, Rohan sits at Priya's original seat.
So that exact seat is:
- 22nd from left (Rohan's new rank)
- 18th from right (Priya's original rank)
Total students = (Rank from Left + Rank from Right) - 1
Total = 22 + 18 - 1 = 40 - 1 = 39.
sample_pyq_records.solution_hi:
स्थान परिवर्तन के बाद रोहन, प्रिया के मूल स्थान पर बैठता है।
अतः वह स्थान बाएँ से 22वाँ और दाएँ से 18वाँ है।
कुल छात्र = (बाएँ से स्थान + दाएँ से स्थान) - 1
कुल = 22 + 18 - 1 = 39 छात्र।
sample_pyq_records.shortcut: Interchange Shortcut: Total = (New rank of moving person + Old rank of stationary person) - 1 = 22 + 18 - 1 = 39.
sample_pyq_records.exam_trick: Never draw individual dots for 39 people. Simply add new rank + other person's old rank and subtract 1.
